message: Cover: Template 2026.1 title on full-bleed green gradient with layered translucent triangles.
layout_trick: Full-bleed brand-green gradient with translucent angled facets and a giant white logotype; title underlined by a thin rule, authors bottom-right.

message: Intelbras is a scaled, entrenched platform growing 19.3% CAGR across Security, ICT and Energy.
layout_trick: Three-column at-a-glance: dashed-outline callout with bold key numbers, Brazil map with TAC tiers, revenue columns with margin line and CAGR bubble, BU mix stacked bars.

message: Three addressable markets (ICT, Energy, Security) with distinct dynamics outgrow Brazilian GDP.
layout_trick: 2x2 grid: each quadrant has a bold headline + italic grey chart descriptor; bottom row has three bordered mini-cards with a diamond bullet and one bold stat each.

message: Investment thesis: BUY, built on channel distribution, portfolio monetization and structural growth avenue.
layout_trick: Section divider that doubles as thesis map: three circular-icon pillars on an arc around the logo, the active pillar bold and the others faded, with a BUY stamp.

message: A multi-tier channel (Supplier, Intelbras, Distributor, Reseller, Consumer) with 80k resellers is the moat.
layout_trick: Bottom row is a five-step value-chain strip with icons and dark green vertical separators; expert quote card with headshot in grey box adds primary evidence.

message: Security clients pull ICT products: a cross-sell engine across three BUs.
layout_trick: Cross-sell matrix as a green heatmap table (product x product % of clients) next to an illustrative scene image with labelled callouts.

message: Reseller loyalty is sustained by incentive and training programs, proven by a reseller field survey.
layout_trick: Primary research shown inline: survey bar chart with n-callout, photo strip of resellers, and a quote box with portrait and name.

message: Dense reseller network around Sao Paulo: avg distance 1.35 km to nearest reseller.
layout_trick: Zoom-in map pair (region then city) with a Google heat map overlay and dashed callouts carrying the two headline KPIs.

message: Coca-Cola playbook: market dominance is built on distribution, not product, and Intelbras replicates it.
layout_trick: Analogy slide: left shows the Coca-Cola bottler flow with logos and arrows, right shows the same playbook applied to Intelbras with line charts and icon rows.

message: Cash conversion cycle is lower than Chinese peers thanks to distributor relationships and days sales outstanding.
layout_trick: Peer comparison as grouped bars (Intelbras vs Dahua vs Hikvision) in three colors, repeated for CCC and DSO with a program callout and a CFO quote portrait.

message: Capillary distribution plus trained installers and post-sale support build customer trust above sector NPS.
layout_trick: Left: formula box (capillarity + installer + support = trust); right: scatter of Reclame Aqui score vs resolution rate with logos as markers.

message: Chinese import surge and two branded giants (Hikvision, Dahua) erode Intelbras market share.
layout_trick: Marketplace screenshot as evidence next to market-share donut and a scatter of price vs post-sale level.

message: White label targets a different buyer, so substitution is structurally weak.
layout_trick: Technology adoption bell curve with white label vs Intelbras positioned on it, plus a small cross-price elasticity bar chart.

message: Security revenue grows despite share loss; ICT loses both revenue and share in a price-only market.
layout_trick: Pyramid of segment pressure (enterprise to DIY) with price-sensitivity labels, plus a Sao Paulo state map with price-dispersion sigma.

message: Portfolio pivot: Intelbras deliberately cut revenue to protect returns.
layout_trick: Mix shift stacked bars with an icon strip of four pivot drivers beneath, ending in a CEO quote box.

message: Margin over volume: gross profit per BRL of G&A and ticket rose while revenue was cut.
layout_trick: Dashed rounded highlight box on the latest year across the chart, with a pivot-year marker; two-by-two grid with captions below each chart.

message: Investment cycle is over: capex cooled and the company is entering harvest mode with free cash flow back.
layout_trick: Curved green arrow connecting capex trough to FCF recovery, annotating the story across two charts.

message: ROIC stayed above WACC even at the trough; the 2025 inflection widens the spread.
layout_trick: ROIC vs WACC line with spread KPI boxes (13.8% vs 11.6%, +2.2pp) and WACC composition donut.

message: Security market is a growth flywheel: dominant 43% share, 13% annual growth, 58% perceive rising crime.
layout_trick: Key information panel with three big icons over one number each, plus numbered claims.

message: Khomp acquisition validates the recurring revenue model: R$455mn gross revenue growing, 40% recurring.
layout_trick: Vertical icon list in dark green squares with one fact each, beside a growth chart and a dashed-box 'what if at Intelbras scale' ARR comparison (R$140mn vs R$370mn).

message: AI turns cameras into subscription platforms: a business-model shift with data monetization.
layout_trick: With AI vs without AI comparison box and a color-scaled demand sensitivity table (price vs potential demand).

message: Smart cities open a new battleground as global Chinese vendors face restrictions.
layout_trick: Mini timeline of regulatory events with arrows, plus a nested concentric-circle TAM visual for the market sizing.

message: ICT market grows 8.6% CAGR to 2034 while Intelbras shifts from volume to margin.
layout_trick: Market-size column chart with CAGR bubble and exec quote card; below, a three-row icon-circle list of segment shifts.

message: Fragmented ISP landscape and policy (Lei das TICs, BNDES) favor local producers.
layout_trick: Horizontal stacked bars (regional vs big ISPs) and a three-input policy box with arrows to quantified financing savings.

message: Anti-dumping resets competitive dynamics for fiber optic: price discipline and less competition.
layout_trick: Before/after anti-dumping price comparison (US$/m) with a big green arrow and gap callouts.

message: SME connectivity is a vastly uncaptured market monetized through cross-sell.
layout_trick: Cross-sell visual: house icon to building icon, equals sign, with stacked horizontal 'multiple revenue streams' bars.

message: Professional management and a family-controlled but Novo Mercado-protected shareholder structure.
layout_trick: Diamond-cropped executive portraits with name, role and tenure, beside a treemap of shareholder structure and rating badges.

message: Risk analysis: macro, competitive and business risks plotted probability x impact.
layout_trick: Impact x probability scatter with coded squares (M1, C2, B3) colored by risk family, legend as three colored boxes on the right. Not quantified.

message: From telecom PBX roots to a technology powerhouse: 50 years of expansion and acquisitions.
layout_trick: Dense horizontal timeline with circle decade markers on the axis, events alternating above and below, grouped by period.

message: All three Intelbras markets (security, ICT, energy) are expanding independently of the cycle.
layout_trick: Three-column layout with a dark-outlined key-information box at top and a bar chart below per column, keeping identical structure.

message: UEL case: Intelbras delivered an integrated end-to-end platform, not a standalone product.
layout_trick: Case study: vertical icon stack of five delivered modules with bold title and one-line spec, triangle funnel of problems at bottom.

message: ERP transition to SAP S/4HANA caused short-term disorder but brings structural payoff.
layout_trick: Left to right causal story: problem box, chart showing the hit, upside, linked by a down-arrow; quote with executive portrait.

message: 71% of Intelbras Security revenue is protected from white label; only R$791mn is exposed.
layout_trick: Quantified risk exposure: stacked 71%/29% bar flowing into funnel breakdown, with protected vs exposed bars across peers.

message: Capital allocation: 25% minimum payout, payout rose to 62% as FCO inflects.
layout_trick: Dividends bars with payout line, next to a stacked FCO allocation chart (dividends, capex, M&A, retained) with a green curved arrow marking the inflection.

message: Capital deployed post-IPO was funded conservatively with debt kept low.
layout_trick: Diamond-icon capex timeline with dated bullet descriptions on the left, funding chart on the right and a boxed IPO/debenture takeaways list.

message: Technology platform: acquisitions (Renovigi, Khomp, Allume, Seventh) consolidate the portfolio.
layout_trick: Logo lineup of acquired companies with one-line stats each (ARR, revenue, acquired year), next to a revenue line annotated with acquisition markers.

message: Net cash position across cycle; consolidated leverage well below sector peers.
layout_trick: Net debt vs EBITDA bars with leverage line, and a peer-comparison bar chart with a dashed reference line.

message: Four layers of tax incentives form a structural cost advantage worth R$170mn a year.
layout_trick: Pyramid of four tax regimes labelled with their expiry, waterfall from statutory to actual tax burden, and plant-location photos by region.

message: Margin recovery is an execution story: DIO falls and gross margin recovers vs FX.
layout_trick: Three-signal confirmation box ('inflection is ahead') under a quarterly DIO and gross margin chart with FX exposure lines.

message: Solar BU: fast growth then a setback, caught between rising rates and falling system prices.
layout_trick: Dashed rectangle around the peak-to-decline revenue bars with a hand-drawn style annotation; line chart of Selic vs system price on the right.

message: Energy BU mix shifted from solar dependency to a diversified platform (UPS, EV, batteries).
layout_trick: Icon row for four energy segments atop a stacked mix chart for 2022 vs 2025, and a capex-per-revenue line.

message: Chinese players lead in scale and price; Brazilian energy market is highly fragmented with 46% long tail.
layout_trick: Donut with company logo legend listing players, three footer KPI chips with flag icons.

message: Intelbras is neither the cheapest nor the best product; the channel is the real barrier.
layout_trick: Product-by-product price comparison cards: product photo of competitor vs Intelbras with price tags, bullet list of why channel cannot be copied.

message: Macro volatility (Selic, BRL, FX) is absorbed by hedging and by distributors, resellers and end-customers as buffers.
layout_trick: Vertical chevron stack Intelbras / Distributors / Resellers / End customers, each row with a 'buffer' definition box.

message: Competitive landscape by category: global brands vs Intelbras, with Dahua as both competitor and supplier.
layout_trick: Logo grid grouped by product category (CCTV, FDAS, Alarms, Access control) with dashed risk boxes for supplier dependence.

message: ICT competitive landscape: Chinese cost asymmetry and invisible white-label imports.
layout_trick: Category-to-logo map (Networks, Optical, Cables, USB, Wifi, Software) with a grey Chinese-share callout bubble.

message: Intelbras trades at a 44-79% discount to peers on every multiple; fundamentals do not justify the gap.
layout_trick: Left: single-metric peer bars with 'discount to median' callout; right: grouped bars across four multiples with discount pct. labels above each Intelbras bar.

message: ROIC decline driven by capital turnover compression, not by margin deterioration.
layout_trick: DuPont decomposition as three curved lines (ROIC, NOPAT margin, capital turnover) with data labels in colored pills.

message: WACC calculation by year: 10.8% to 13.9% from Ke, Kd and capital structure.
layout_trick: Formula card in black box above a yearly table with the result column highlighted in yellow.

message: Demand function with bear, base and bull scenarios on reseller software adoption and price sensitivity.
layout_trick: Red-to-green sensitivity grid (price x reseller base) beside three scenario calculation tables colored by case.

message: Potential ARR for software ranges R$255mn to R$524mn depending on incremental ticket.
layout_trick: Pessimistic/conservative/optimistic table with a yellow premises header block.
